name: cropper
blurb: Interactive image cropper with drag repositioning and scroll-to-zoom controls.
description: Wraps @origin-space/image-cropper with styled sub-components. Displays an image with a draggable crop area overlay. Supports pinch zoom and scroll zoom within min/max bounds.
use_when: User-facing image upload flows that require precise cropping before save.
avoid_when: Read-only image galleries or touch-only interfaces without scroll wheel zoom.
a11y: Image has a sr-only description. Crop area shows focus ring. Drag and scroll interactions lack keyboard alternatives.
